logLevelRemap.description: Renovate logs this warning whenever a timestamp-optional packageRule raises an update that has no release timestamp. The cachix/git-hooks.nix and SchemaStore rules set timestamp-optional as a fallback for a github-digest lookup that comes back without a commit date; at warn level each such update would sit under the dependency dashboard's Repository problems. The rules that set timestamp-optional say why each accepts that; the message stays in the job log at info.
logLevelRemap.matchMessage: /^Some release\(s\) did not have a releaseTimestamp/

packageRules.description: github-actions: pin SHAs and auto-merge after the 7-day quarantine. Per-manager automerge scope ensures a future manager activation (e.g. npm via a new package.json) does NOT inherit automerge. A digest-only repoint (SHA moves, version label unchanged) is blocked at PR time by scripts/check-pin-digest-provenance.sh in the lint-doc-invariants group. A PR from this manager that changes a runs-on: label in ci.yml gets the runner-label docs regenerated on its branch by renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml; a label actionlint or octoscan does not know yet still needs a person to allowlist it (see docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md).

Nix install URL: scoped automerge for the same reason as github-actions. The custom manager below extracts the version from the pinned Nix install URL. matchDepNames narrows this rule to 'nix'; every other custom-regex dependency in this file carries its own automerge rule below, so each scope stays explicit per dependency rather than blanket.

NixOS/nixpkgs stable branch: automerge once every required check passes. Blast radius is the linpeas runtime derivation and the image base layer; the tooling layer follows nixpkgs-unstable and does not move with the YY.MM branch. Part of the fallout (CVE-scan output, dashboard rebuild) surfaces on a later cron run rather than on this PR's own checks. Recovery for that case is a revert. renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml supplies the lockfile this manager cannot write; see docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md for the triage tables.

cachix/git-hooks.nix master HEAD: automerge once every required check passes. renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml supplies the lockfile this manager cannot write; while flake.nix is ahead of flake.lock the flake-check job is red, so the PR cannot merge before the refresh lands. github-digest ages a master-HEAD digest against its commit date, so minimumReleaseAge applies when Renovate reads one; a commit date is set by the committer, so it is a weaker age signal than a registry push time. timestamp-optional is the fallback: should a release come back without a timestamp, it is raised with no age check rather than held forever, and the required checks named here remain its gate.

SchemaStore/schemastore master HEAD: automerge once every required check passes. The pin feeds scripts/check-jsonschema.sh, which validates this repo's JSON and YAML against the bumped SHA in CI, so a schema set that rejects a tracked file keeps the PR red. github-digest ages a master-HEAD digest against its commit date, so minimumReleaseAge applies when Renovate reads one; a commit date is set by the committer, so it is a weaker age signal than a registry push time. timestamp-optional is the fallback: should a release come back without a timestamp, it is raised with no age check rather than held forever, and the required checks named here remain its gate.

TruffleHog release version: scoped automerge after the 7-day quarantine, for the same reason as github-actions. matchDepNames narrows this rule to the TruffleHog release so each custom-regex dependency keeps its own explicit automerge scope. GitHub releases carry a publish timestamp, so the default timestamp-required behaviour applies. The PR's own trufflehog run is its gate: it verifies the new tag's signed checksums and scans with the new binary, and a release that does not verify keeps the PR red.

customManagers.description: cachix/git-hooks.nix master HEAD tracker. Uses the github-digest datasource because that repo publishes 0 GitHub releases and 0 tags — master HEAD is the only upstream-truth signal — and github-digest, unlike git-refs, reports the commit date as a release timestamp, so minimumReleaseAge can age the update (see the packageRule). This manager only substitutes the SHA in flake.nix; renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml runs `nix flake update pre-commit-hooks` on the PR branch and commits the refreshed flake.lock. Until that commit lands the PR is red and cannot merge. When the auto-refresh does not fire, an issue is filed under the renovate-flake-lock-refresh-failure label and the manual fallback is in docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md.

NixOS/nixpkgs stable branch tracker. Captures the YY.MM suffix of the nixos-YY.MM branch in flake.nix and watches NixOS/nixpkgs tags for new YY.MM tags (versioningTemplate restricts to MAJOR.MINOR form). NixOS tags only at GA, so this naturally proposes the next stable branch when it ships. This manager only substitutes the branch name in flake.nix; renovate-flake-lock-refresh.yml runs `nix flake update nixpkgs` on the PR branch and commits the refreshed flake.lock, and the PR stays red until it does. Expect downstream side-effects (image base-layer rotation, new bundled coreutils/bash versions, CRITICAL CVEs in the runtime payload) — see docs/architecture/flake-input-bumps.md for the triage tables.

SchemaStore master HEAD tracker for the JSON Schema URLs consumed by scripts/check-jsonschema.sh. Same shape as the cachix/git-hooks.nix manager — SchemaStore publishes 0 releases and 0 tags, master HEAD is the only upstream-truth signal. Renovate ages each new master HEAD against its commit date (see the packageRule). The bumped SHA is what check-jsonschema.sh validates against in CI, so a schema set that rejects a tracked file keeps the PR red.

TruffleHog release version in .github/trufflehog-version, read by scripts/trufflehog-release.sh. The trufflehog workflow verifies the release's checksums file against upstream's keyless cosign signature for that exact tag before any binary runs, so a version bump needs no digest pinned in this repo: the signature is the trust anchor, and a release asset re-uploaded under an unchanged tag cannot leave a stale digest that blocks main. Upstream tags are v-prefixed and the file holds the bare X.Y.Z, so extractVersion strips the prefix.
